semantics.amounts: decimal strings preserve exact integer output-cell balances; deltas are not amounts that may be summed as payments
semantics.attribution: movements are emitted only when every input cell has one exact source owner; multi-owner merges stay ambiguous
semantics.event_unit: one complete token state transition; split and merge deltas never cross pages
semantics.owner_filter: matches indexed owner_from or owner_to fields; ambiguous multi-owner source identities are intentionally unavailable
